\n1d8:T86d,\n

Given:

\n\n

Given:

\n\n

Length of train = 180 m

\n\n

Length of tunnel = 500 m

\n\n

Time taken by train to cross the tunnel = 40 sec

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Speed = Distance/Time

\n\n

1 m/s = \\(\\frac{18}{5}\\) km/h

\n\n

Calculations:

\n\n

Speed of train (km/h) = (Length of train + Length of tunnel) / Total time taken to cross the tunnel

\n\n

⇒ Speed of train (m/s) = \\(\\frac{180 + 500}{40}\\)

\n\n

⇒ Speed of train (m/s) =\\(\\frac{680}{40}\\)

\n\n

⇒ Speed of train (m/s) = 17

\n\n

⇒ Speed of train (km/h) = 17 \\( \\times \\frac{18}{5}\\)

\n\n

⇒ Speed of train (km/h) = 61.2

\n\n

∴ The speed of train is 61.2 km/h.

", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

ट्रेन की लंबाई = 180 मीटर

\n\n

सुरंग की लंबाई = 500 मीटर

\n\n

ट्रेन द्वारा सुरंग को पार करने में लगा समय = 40 सेकंड

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

गति = दूरी/समय

\n\n

1 मीटर/सेकंड = \\(\\frac{18}{5}\\) किमी/घंटा 

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

ट्रेन की गति (किमी/घंटा) = (ट्रेन की लंबाई + सुरंग की लंबाई) / सुरंग को पार करने में लगा कुल समय

\n\n

⇒ ट्रेन की गति (मीटर/सेकंड) = \\(\\frac{180 + 500}{40}\\)

\n\n

⇒ ट्रेन की गति (मीटर/सेकंड) =\\(\\frac{680}{40}\\)

\n\n

⇒ ट्रेन की गति (मीटर/सेकंड) = 17

\n\n

⇒ ट्रेन की गति (किमी/घंटा) = 17 \\( \\times \\frac{18}{5}\\)

\n\n

⇒ ट्रेन की गति (किमी/घंटा) = 61.2

\n\n

∴ ट्रेन की गति 61.2 किमी/घंटा है।

\n\n

⇒ Given:

\n\n

Calculations:

\n\n

\n\n

Factors of 30 = 2 × 3 × 5 × 1

\n\n

Factors of 45 = 3 × 3 × 5 ×1

\n\n

Factors of 65 = 5 × 13 × 1

\n\n

\n\n

∴ The answer is 2430.

\n\n

PQ का लंब समद्विभाजक, A और B में बड़े वृत्त से मिलता है।

6 সেমি এবং 4 সেমি ব্যাসার্ধের কেন্দ্র P এবং Q কেন্দ্রবিশিষ্ট দুটি বৃত্ত একে অপরকে অভ্যন্তরীণভাবে স্পর্শ করে।

\n\n

অনুসৃত ধারণা:

\n\n

পিথাগোরাসের উপপাদ্যে বলা হয়েছে যে কর্ণের দৈর্ঘ্যের বর্গটি সমকোণী ত্রিভুজের অন্য দুটি বাহুর দৈর্ঘ্যের বর্গের সমষ্টির সমান।

\n\n

গণনা:

\n\n

\n\n

6 সেমি এবং 4 সেমি ব্যাসার্ধের কেন্দ্র P এবং Q কেন্দ্রবিশিষ্ট দুটি বৃত্ত একে অপরকে অভ্যন্তরীণভাবে স্পর্শ করে।

\n\n

આપેલ:

\n\n

5 સેમી અને 3 સેમી ત્રિજ્યાના કેન્દ્રો P અને Q સાથેના બે વર્તુળો અનુક્રમે એકબીજાને આંતરિક રીતે સ્પર્શે છે.

\n\n

વપરાયેલ ખ્યાલ:

\n\n

પાયથાગોરસના પ્રમેય જણાવે છે કે કર્ણોની લંબાઈનો વર્ગ જમણા ખૂણાવાળા ત્રિકોણની અન્ય બે બાજુઓની લંબાઈના ચોરસના સરવાળા જેટલો છે.

\n\n

ગણતરીઓ:

\n\n

\n\n

5 સેમી અને 3 સેમી ત્રિજ્યાના કેન્દ્રો P અને Q સાથેના બે વર્તુળો અનુક્રમે એકબીજાને આંતરિક રીતે સ્પર્શે છે.

\n\n

⇒ PQ = 5 - 3 = 2 સે.મી

\n\n

PQ નો લંબ દ્વિભાજક A અને B માં મોટા વર્તુળને મળે છે.

\n\n

કાટખૂણે દ્વિભાજક PQ ને O પર વિભાજિત કરીએ.

\n\n

⇒ PO = PQ/2 = 1 સે.મી

\n\n

Δ POA એ O પર જમણો-કોણ ત્રિકોણ છે.

\n\n

પાયથાગોરસના પ્રમેયનો ઉપયોગ કરીને

\n\n

PA 2 = PO 2 + AO 2

\n\n

⇒ 6 2 = 1 2 + AO 2

\n\n

⇒ AO 2 = 35

\n\n

⇒ AO = √35

\n\n

પ્રશ્ન મુજબ,

\n\n

AB = 2 x AO

\n\n

= 2 √ 35 સે.મી

\n\n

∴ AB ની કિંમત 2 √ 35 cm છે.

\n\n

ਕੇਂਦਰ P ਅਤੇ Q ਵਾਲੇ ਦੋ ਚੱਕਰ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਅਰਧ ਵਿਆਸ ਕ੍ਰਮਵਾਰ 6 cm ਅਤੇ 4 cm ਹੈ, ਇੱਕ ਦੂਜੇ ਨੂੰ ਅੰਦਰੂਨੀ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਛੂਹਦੇ ਹਨ।

cos (40° - A) ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଖୋଜ |", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "2"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "0"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "-1"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "1"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

If the sum of two angles is 90°, then sin θ1 = cos θ2.

\n

Check the sum of the given angles: (50° + A) + (40° − A) = 90°.

\n

Thus, sin(50° + A) = cos(40° − A).

\n

Subtracting them directly gives: sin(50° + A) − cos(40° − A) = 0.

\n

∴ The correct answer is 0.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Expression: sin(50° + A) − cos(40° − A)

\n

Formula Used:

\n

sin θ = cos(90° − θ)

\n\n\n\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Let θ = 50° + A

\n

⇒ Using the complementary angle formula: sin θ = cos(90° − θ)

\n

⇒ sin(50° + A) = cos(90° − (50° + A))

\n

⇒ sin(50° + A) = cos(90° − 50° − A)

\n

⇒ sin(50° + A) = cos(40° − A)

\n

⇒ Substitute this result into the original expression:

\n

⇒ cos(40° − A) − cos(40° − A) = 0

\n

∴ The correct answer is 0.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Complementary Angles

\n

Two angles are complementary if their sum is 90°. Key formulas: sin(90° − θ) = cos θ, sec(90° − θ) = cosec θ, and tan(90° − θ) = cot θ.

\n

Supplementary Angles

\n

Two angles are supplementary if their sum is 180°. Key formulas: sin(180° − θ) = sin θ, and cos(180° − θ) = −cos θ.

\n

Basic Trigonometric Identities

\n

1) sin2θ + cos2θ = 1
2) sec2θ − tan2θ = 1
3) cosec2θ − cot2θ = 1

Given:

\n\n

Final amount in 4 years (A1) = Rs 7656

\n\n

Time (t1) = 4 years

\n\n

Final amount in 5 years(A2) = Rs 8120

\n\n

Time(t2) = 5 years

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

A = P(1 + rt)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let, principal amount = y

\n\n

Now use formula for 4 years

\n\n

A1 = P(1+rt)

\n\n

⇒ 7656 = y(1+r× 4)

\n\n

⇒ 7656 = y + 4ry

\n\n

⇒ y = 7656 / (1+4r) ---- (1)

\n\n

∵ useing the formula for 5 years

\n\n

⇒ 8120 = y(1 + 5r)

\n\n

⇒ 8120 = y + 5ry

\n\n

Factorize both quadratic expressions by identifying the factors of the constant term that ", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Profit and Loss"], "concept": "Profit & Loss", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6527f14107a6efb11728b7d3", "qs_no": 26, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "The LCM of x2 - 8x + 15 and x2 - 5x + 6 is:", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "(x - 2)(x - 3)<span style="position: relative; line-height: 0; vertical-align: baseline; top: -0.5em;font-size:10.5px;">2</span>(x - 5)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "(x + 5)(x + 2)(x + 3)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "(x + 5)(x - 2)(x - 3)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "(x - 5)(x - 2)(x - 3)"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "x2 - 8x + 15 और x2 - 5x + 6 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य क्या है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "(x - 2)(x - 3)2(x - 5)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "(x + 5)(x + 2)(x + 3)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "(x + 5)(x - 2)(x - 3)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "(x - 5)(x - 2)(x - 3)"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "bn": {"value": "x2 - 8x + 15 এবং x2 - 5x + 6 এর ল.সা.গু হল:", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "(x - 2)(x - 3)2(x - 5)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "(x + 5)(x + 2)(x + 3)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "(x + 5)(x - 2)(x - 3)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "(x - 5)(x - 2)(x - 3)"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

Factorize both quadratic expressions by identifying the factors of the constant term that sum to the middle coefficient.

\n

x2 − 8x + 15 → Factors of 15 that sum to −8 are −3 and −5 → (x − 3)(x − 5)

\n

x2 − 5x + 6 → Factors of 6 that sum to −5 are −2 and −3 → (x − 3)(x − 2)

\n

LCM is the product of all unique factors appearing in the expressions: (x − 3), (x − 5), and (x − 2).

\n

∴ The correct answer is (x − 5)(x − 2)(x − 3).

\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given expressions:

\n

P(x) = x2 − 8x + 15

\n

Q(x) = x2 − 5x + 6

\n

To find the LCM, we first factorize each polynomial completely.

\n

⇒ P(x) = x2 − 5x − 3x + 15

\n

⇒ P(x) = x(x − 5) − 3(x − 5) = (x − 5)(x − 3)

\n

⇒ Q(x) = x2 − 3x − 2x + 6

\n

⇒ Q(x) = x(x − 3) − 2(x − 3) = (x − 3)(x − 2)

\n

⇒ LCM is the product of the highest powers of all prime factors present in the expressions.

\n

⇒ LCM [P(x), Q(x)] = (x − 3)1 × (x − 5)1 × (x − 2)1

\n

⇒ LCM = (x − 5)(x − 2)(x − 3)

\n

∴ The correct answer is (x − 5)(x − 2)(x − 3).

\n

Additional Information

\n

HCF of Polynomials

\n

The Highest Common Factor (HCF) is the product of common factors with the lowest power. Here, the common factor is (x − 3), so HCF = (x − 3).

\n

Relation between HCF and LCM

\n

For any two polynomials P(x) and Q(x), the relationship is: P(x) × Q(x) = HCF(P, Q) × LCM(P, Q).

\n

Factoring Quadratic Trinomials

\n

A quadratic trinomial x2 + bx + c is factored into (x + p)(x + q) where p × q = c and p + q = b. Shortcut Trick\n

दोनों द्विघात व्यंजकों का गुणनखंड करने के लिए अचर पद के ऐसे गुणनखंड ज्ञात कीजिए जिनका योग मध्य पद के गुणांक के बराबर हो।

\n

x2 − 8x + 15 → 15 के ऐसे गुणनखंड जिनका योग −8 है, −3 और −5 हैं → (x − 3)(x − 5)

\n

x2 − 5x + 6 → 6 के ऐसे गुणनखंड जिनका योग −5 है, −2 और −3 हैं → (x − 3)(x − 2)

\n

LCM व्यंजकों में आने वाले सभी अद्वितीय गुणनखंडों का गुणनफल होता है: (x − 3), (x − 5), और (x − 2)।

\n

∴ सही उत्तर (x − 5)(x − 2)(x − 3) है।

\n

Given:

\n\n

Robert takes to complete a work = 2 × Tom's work = 3 × George's work

\n\n

Working together they can complete a work = 23 hours

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

⇒ Let George take to complete a work = 2y

\n\n

⇒ Tom takes to complete a work = 3y

\n\n

⇒ Robert take to complete a work = 6y

\n\n

Total work = LCM of (2y + 3y + 6y) = 6y

\n\n

Efficiency of all three = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6

\n\n

Time taken by all of them to complete the work = total work/efficiency

\n\n

⇒ 6y/6 = y

\n\n

⇒ Working together they can complete a work = 23 hours

\n\n

y = 23

\n\n

⇒ Now Tom will take to complete the work = 3y = 23 × 3 = 69 hours

\n\n

∴The correct answer is 69 hours.

ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

\n\n

ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ರಾಬರ್ಟ್ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = 2 x ಟಾಮ್‌ ಅವರ ಕೆಲಸ = 3 x ಜಾರ್ಜ್‌ ಅವರ ಕೆಲಸ

\n\n

ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಅವರು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಬಹುದು = 23 ಗಂಟೆಗಳು

\n\n

ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

\n\n

⇒ ಜಾರ್ಜ್ ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = 2y ಆಗಿರಲಿ

\n\n

⇒ ಟಾಮ್ ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = 3y

\n\n

⇒ ರಾಬರ್ಟ್ ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = 6y

\n\n

ಒಟ್ಟು ಕೆಲಸ = (2y + 3y + 6y) ರ ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ. = 6y

\n\n

ಮೂರು ಜನರ ದಕ್ಷತೆ = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6

\n\n

ಅವರೆಲ್ಲರೂ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = ಒಟ್ಟು ಕೆಲಸ/ದಕ್ಷತೆ

\n\n

⇒ 6y/6 = y

\n\n

⇒ ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಅವರು ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಬಹುದು = 23 ಗಂಟೆಗಳು

\n\n

y = 23

\n\n

⇒ ಈಗ ಟಾಮ್ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = 3y = 23 x 3 = 69 ಗಂಟೆಗಳು

\n\n

∴ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ 69 ಗಂಟೆಗಳು.

\n\n

\n\n

According to the question

\n\n

OQ = OP = 6 cm

\n\n

Since the radius of a circle is the perpendicular bisector of a chord , so

\n\n

PA = AQ = 5 cm

\n\n

In right angled triangle OAQ

\n\n

OQ2  = OA2  + AQ2

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ OA2 = 11

\n\n

⇒ OA = \\(\\sqrt11\\) cm

\n\n

∴ The radius of a inner circle is \\(\\sqrt11\\)cm.

\n\n

ಪ್ರಮೇಯ: ವೃತ್ತದ ಯಾವುದೇ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಕವು ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಾದುಹೋಗುವ ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಲಂಬವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

\n\n

ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

\n\n

\n\n

ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ

\n\n

OQ = OP = 6 ಸೆಂ.ಮೀ

\n\n

ವೃತ್ತದ ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯವು ಜ್ಯಾದ ಲಂಬ ಸಮದ್ವಿಭಾಜಕವಾಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ,

\n\n

PA = AQ = 5 ಸೆಂ.ಮೀ

\n\n

ಲಂಬಕೋನ ತ್ರಿಭುಜ OAQ ನಲ್ಲಿ

\n\n

OQ2 = OA2 + AQ2கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

\n\n

வெளி வட்டத்தின் ஆரம் = 6 செ.மீ

\n\n

10 செ.மீ நீளமுள்ள நாண் PQ என்பது உள் வட்டத்திற்கு தொடுகோடாக உள்ளது.

\n\n

கருத்து:

\n\n

பிதாகரஸ் தேற்றம்: செங்கோண முக்கோணத்தில், கர்ணத்தின் வர்க்கம் மற்ற இரு பக்கங்களின் வர்க்கங்களின் கூடுதலுக்குச் சமம்.

\n\n

தேற்றம்: வட்டத்தின் எந்த ஒரு புள்ளியிலும் தொடுகோடு, தொடும் புள்ளி வழியாகச் செல்லும் ஆரத்திற்கு செங்குத்தாக இருக்கும்.

\n\n

கணக்கீடு:

\n\n

\n\n

கேள்வியின்படி

\n\n

OQ = OP = 6 செ.மீ

\n\n

வட்டத்தின் ஆரம் நாணின் செங்குத்து இருசமவெட்டியாக இருப்பதால்,

\n\n

PA = AQ = 5 செ.மீ

\n\n

செங்கோண முக்கோணம் OAQ இல்

\n\n

OQ2 = OA2 + AQ2

\n\n

⇒ OA2 = (6)2 - (5)2

\n\n

⇒ OA2 = 11

\n\n

⇒ OA = \\(\\sqrt11\\) செ.மீ

\n\n

∴ உள் வட்டத்தின் ஆரம் \\(\\sqrt11\\) செ.மீ.

\n\n

சரியான விடை\n: 4)\\(\\sqrt11\\) செ.மீ

Given: 

\n\n

A quadrilateral plot one diagonal =  20 m 

\n\n

lengths of the perpendiculars from the opposite vertices on it are 12 m and 18 m

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

\n\n

The diagonal AC divides the quadrilateral into two triangles.

\n\n

The triangles are \\(\\Delta \\)ABC and \\(\\Delta \\)ADC.

\n\n

Let the perpendiculars dropped be M and N respectively.

\n\n

⇒ BM = 18 m and DN = 12 m

\n\n

Now, area of \\(\\Delta \\)ABC = (1/2) × 20×18 = 180m²

\n\n

Similarly, area of \\(\\Delta \\)ADC = (1/2) × 20 × 12= 120m²

\n\n

∴ Total area of a quadrilateral  =  Area(\\(\\Delta \\)АВС + \\(\\Delta \\)​ADC) = 180 + 120 = 300 m²

\n\n

Correct Answer: 4) 300 m2

\n\n

\n\n

त्रिभुज \\(\\Delta \\)ABC और \\(\\Delta \\)ADC हैं।

\n\n

माना कि खींचे गए लम्ब क्रमशः M और N हैं।

\n\n

⇒ BM = 18 मीटर और DN = 12 मीटर

\n\n

अब, \\(\\Delta \\)ABC का क्षेत्रफल = (1/2) × 20×18 = 180 मीटर2

\n\n

इसी प्रकार, \\(\\Delta \\)ADC का क्षेत्रफल = (1/2) × 20 × 12= 120 मीटर2

\n\n

सही उत्तर: 4) 300 मीटर2

"solution_html": {"en": "\n

Given:

\n\n

A family total income = Rs75000

\n\n

out of which 10% is saved.

\n\n

30% of the expenditure is incurred on education,

\n\n

while, spent on health =  Rs. 30,375  

\n\n

the remaining amount is spent on food

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

A family  total savings = 75000 × (10/100) = Rs.7500

\n\n

Remaining amount = 75000 - 7500 = Rs.67500

\n\n

Spent on education = 67500 × (30/100) = Rs.20250

\n\n

Remaining amount after spent on education & health = 67500 - 20250 - 30375 

\n\n

= Rs.16875

\n\n

Amount spent on Food = Rs.16875

\n\n

∴ Required percentage = (16875/75000) × 100

\n\n

 = 22.5%

\n\n

Correct Answer: 2) 22.5%

", "hn": "

दिया गया है:

\n\n

एक परिवार की कुल आय = 75000 रुपये

\n\n

जिसमें से 10% की बचत की जाती है।

\n\n

30% शिक्षा पर खर्च किया जाता है।

\n\n

जबकि, स्वास्थ्य पर खर्च = 30,375 रुपये

\n\n

शेष राशि भोजन पर खर्च की जाती है।

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

एक परिवार की कुल बचत = 75000 × (10/100) = 7500 रुपये

\n\n

शेष राशि = 75000 - 7500 = 67500 रुपये

\n\n

शिक्षा पर खर्च = 67", "te": "

ఇచ్చినది:

\n\n

కుటుంబం మొత్తం ఆదాయం = రూ.75000

\n\n

అందులో 10% ఆదా అవుతుంది.

\n\n

30% ఖర్చు విద్యపై వెచ్చిస్తారు,

\n\n

అయితే, ఆరోగ్యంపై ఖర్చు = రూ. 30,375

\n\n

మిగిలిన మొత్తాన్ని ఆహారం కోసం ఖర్చు చేస్తారు

\n\n

గణన:

\n\n

కుటుంబం మొత్తం పొదుపు = 75000 × (10/100) = రూ.7500

\n\n

మిగిలిన మొత్తం = 75000 - 7500 = రూ.67500

\n\n

విద్యపై ఖర్చు = 67500 × (3 0/100) = రూ.20250

\n\n

విద్య & ఆరోగ్యంపై ఖర్చు చేసిన తర్వాత మిగిలిన మొత్తం = 67500 - 2", "mr": "

दिलेले आहे:

\n\n

कुटुंबाचे एकूण उत्पन्न = 75000 रुपये 

\n\n

त्यापैकी 10% बचत होते.

\n\n

30% खर्च शिक्षणावर केला जातो,

\n\n

तर, आरोग्यावर खर्च = 30,375 रुपये 

\n\n

उर्वरित रक्कम अन्नावर खर्च केली जाते

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

कुटुंबाची एकूण बचत = 75000 x (10/100) = 7500 रुपये

\n\n

उर्वरित रक्कम = 75000 - 7500 = 67500 रुप\nये

\n\n

शिक्षणावर खर्च = 67500 x (3 0/100) = 20250 रुपये

\n\n

शिक्षण आणि आरोग्यावर खर्च केल्यानंतर उर्वरित रक्कम = 67500 - 20250 - 30375

\n\n

= 16875 रुपये

\n\n

Given:

\n\n

Time taken by A is 2.4 times taken by B and C together

\n\n

A and B can complete a work in 27 days

\n\n

C can complete a work in 75 days

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

Time taken to complete a piece of work is inversely proportional to efficiency

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let time taken by B and C together to complete a work = X

\n\n

⇒ Time taken by A to complete a work = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ Efficiency of B and C = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ Similarly, Efficiency of A = X

\n\n

⇒ Total Efficiency of A + B + C = 2.4X + X = 3.4X ----(1)

\n\n

Now,

\n\n

If A + B complete a work in 27 days and C alone complete a work in 75 days

\n\n

⇒ Total work = 675 (LCM of 27 and 75 = 675)

\n\n

⇒ Efficiency of A + B = 25 ((675 / 27) = 25)

\n\n

⇒ Similarly, Efficiency of C = 9 ((675 / 75) = 9)

\n\n

⇒ Total Efficiency of A + B + C = 34                ----------(2)

\n\n

Equation (1) = (2)

\n\n

⇒ 3.4X = 34

\n\n

⇒ X = 10 (Efficiency of A)

\n\n

⇒ When efficiency of A + B is 25 then efficiency of B will be

\n\n

⇒ Efficiency of B = 25 - 10 = 15

\n\n

⇒ Time taken by B alone to complete a work = 675/15 = 45 days

\n\n

∴ The correct answer is 45 days.

\n\n

Shortcut Trick 

", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

A द्वारा लिया गया समय B और C द्वारा मिलकर लिया गया समय का 2.4 गुना है।

\n\n

A और B एक कार्य को 27 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं।

\n\n

C एक कार्य को 75 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

किसी कार्य को पूरा करने में लगने वाला समय दक्षता के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होता है।

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

माना B और C द्वारा एक साथ मिलकर एक कार्य को पूरा करने में लिया गया समय = X

\n\n

⇒ A द्वारा एक कार्य पूरा करने में लिया गया समय = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ B और C की दक्षता = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ इसी प्रकार, A की दक्षता = X

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C की कुल दक्षता = 2.4X + X = 3.4X ----(1)

\n\n

अब,

\n\n

यदि A + B एक कार्य को 27 दिनों में पूरा करते हैं और C अकेले एक कार्य को 75 दिनों में पूरा करता है।

\n\n

⇒ कुल कार्य = 675 (27 और 75 का
\nलघुत्तम समापवर्त्य = 675)

\n\n

⇒ A + B की दक्षता = 25 ((675 / 27) = 25)

\n\n

⇒ इसी प्रकार, C की दक्षता = 9 ((675 / 75) = 9)

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C की कुल दक्षता = 34 -------(2)

\n\n

समीकरण (1) = (2)

\n\n

⇒ 3.4X = 34

\n\n

⇒ X = 10 (A की दक्षता)

\n\n

⇒ जब A + B की दक्षता 25 है, तो B की दक्षता होगी

\n\n

⇒ B की दक्षता = 25 - 10 = 15

\n\n

⇒ B द्वारा अकेले किसी कार्य को पूरा करने में लिया गया समय = 675/15 = 45 दिन

\n\n

∴ सही उत्तर 45 दिन है।

\n\n

Shortcut Trick 

\n\n22c:Te5a,\n

ఇచ్చింది:

\n\n

A తీసుకునే సమయం B మరియు C కలిసి తీసుకున్న 2.4 రెట్లు

\n\n

A మరియు B ఒక పనిని 27 రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలరు

\n\n

సి ఒక పనిని 75 రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలదు

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

\n\n

ఒక పనిని పూర్తి చేయడానికి పట్టే సమయం సామర్థ్యానికి విలోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుంది

\n\n

గణన:

\n\n

ఒక పనిని పూర్తి చేయడానికి B మరియు C కలిసి తీసుకున్న సమయాన్ని = X అనుకుందాం

\n\n

⇒ A ఒక పనిని పూర్తి చేయడానికి పట్టే సమయం = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ B మరియు C యొక్క సామర్థ్యం = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ అదేవిధంగా, A యొక్క సామర్థ్యం = X 

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C యొక్క మొత్తం సామర్థ్యం = 2.4X + X = 3.4X ----(1) 

\n\n

ఇప్పుడు,

\n\n

ఒకవేళ A + B ఒక పనిని 27 రోజులలో మరియు C మాత్రమే 75 రోజులలో పూర్తి చేస్తే

\n\n

⇒ మొత్తం పని = 675 (27 మరియు 75 ఇచ్చింది:

\n\n

A తీసుకునే సమయం B మరియు C కలిసి తీసుకున్న 2.4 రెట్లు

\n\n

A మరియు B ఒక పనిని 27 రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలరు

\n\n

సి ఒక పనిని 75 రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలదు

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

\n\n

ఒక పనిని పూర్తి చేయడానికి పట్టే సమయం సామర్థ్యానికి విలోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుంది

\n\n

గణన:

\n\n

ఒక పనిని పూర్తి చేయడానికి B మరియు C కలిసి తీసుకున్న సమయాన్ని = X అనుకుందాం

\n\n

⇒ A ఒక పనిని పూర్తి చేయడానికి పట్టే సమయం = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ B మరియు C యొక్క సామర్థ్యం = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ అదేవిధంగా, A యొక్క సామర్థ్యం = X 

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C యొక్క మొత్తం సామర్థ్యం = 2.4X + X = 3.4X ----(1) 

\n\n

ఇప్పుడు,

\n\n

ఒకవేళ A + B ఒక పనిని 27 రోజులలో మరియు C మాత్రమే 75 రోజులలో పూర్తి చేస్తే

\n\n

⇒ మొత్తం పని = 675 (27 మరియు 75 యొక్క క.సా.గు = 675)

\n\n

⇒ A + B = 25 ((675 / 27) = 25)

\n\n

⇒ అదేవిధంగా, C = 9 ((675 / 75) = 9)

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C యొక్క మొత్తం సామర్థ్యం = 34 ----------(2)

\n\n

సమీకరణం (1) = (2)

\n\n

⇒ 3.4X = 34

\n\n

⇒ X = 10 (A యొక్క సామర్థ్యం)

\n\n

⇒ A + B యొక్క సామర్థ్యం 25 అయినప్పుడు B యొక్క సామర్థ్యం ఉంటుంది

\n\n

⇒ B = 25 - 10 = 15 యొక్క సామర్థ్యం

\n\n

⇒ ఒక పనిని పూర్తి చేయడానికి B మాత్రమే పట్టే సమయం = 675/15 = 45 రోజులు

\n\n

∴ సరైన సమాధానం 45 రోజులు.

\n\n

Shortcut Trick 

\n\n22e:T15ed,\n

প্রদত্ত:

\n\n

A দ্বারা নেওয়া সময় B এবং C এর একসাথে নেওয়া সময়ের 2.4 গুণ 

\n\n

A এবং B একটি কাজ 27 দিনে সম্পূর্ণ করতে পারে

\n\n

C 75 দিনে একটি কাজ সম্পূর্ণ করতে পারে

\n\n

অনুসৃত ধারণা:

\n\n

একটি কাজ সম্পূর্ণ করতে যে সময় লাগে তা দক্ষতার ব্যস্তানুপাতিক।

\n\n

গণনা:

\n\n

একটি কাজ সম্পূর্ণ করতে B এবং C একসাথে সময় নিন = X

\n\n

⇒ একটি কাজ সম্পূর্ণ করতে A এর সময় লাগে = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ B এবং C এর দক্ষতা = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ একইভাবে, A এর দক্ষতা = X 

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C প্রদত্ত:

\n\n

A দ্বারা নেওয়া সময় B এবং C এর একসাথে নেওয়া সময়ের 2.4 গুণ 

\n\n

A এবং B একটি কাজ 27 দিনে সম্পূর্ণ করতে পারে

\n\n

C 75 দিনে একটি কাজ সম্পূর্ণ করতে পারে

\n\n

অনুসৃত ধারণা:

\n\n

একটি কাজ সম্পূর্ণ করতে যে সময় লাগে তা দক্ষতার ব্যস্তানুপাতিক।

\n\n

গণনা:

\n\n

একটি কাজ সম্পূর্ণ করতে B এবং C একসাথে সময় নিন = X

\n\n

⇒ একটি কাজ সম্পূর্ণ করতে A এর সময় লাগে = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ B এবং C এর দক্ষতা = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ একইভাবে, A এর দক্ষতা = X 

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C এর মোট দক্ষতা = 2.4X + X = 3.4X ----(1) 

\n\n

এখন,

\n\n

যদি A + B 27 দিনে একটি কাজ সম্পূর্ণ করে এবং C একা একটি কাজ 75 দিনে সম্পূর্ণ করে

\n\n

⇒ মোট কাজ = 675 (27 এবং 75 এর ল.সা.গু = 675)

\n\n

⇒ A + B এর দক্ষতা = 25  (675 / 27) = 25)

\n\n

⇒ একইভাবে, C এর দক্ষতা = 9  (675 / 75) = 9)

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C এর মোট দক্ষতা = 34  ----------(2)

\n\n

সমীকরণ (1) = (2)

\n\n

⇒ 3.4X = 34

\n\n

⇒ X = 10 (A এর দক্ষতা)

\n\n

⇒ যখন A + B এর দক্ষতা 25 হবে তখন B-এর দক্ষতা হবে

\n\n

⇒ B এর দক্ষতা = 25 - 10 = 15

\n\n

⇒ একটি কাজ সম্পূর্ণ করতে B একাই সময় নেয় = 675/15 = 45 দিন

\n\n

∴ সঠিক উত্তর হল 45 দিন।

\n\n

A દ્વારા લેવાયેલ સમય B અને C દ્વારા એકસાથે લેવાયેલ સમય કરતા 2.4 ગણો છે

વપરાયેલ ખ્યાલ:

ગણતરી:

\n\n

⇒ કાર્ય પૂર્ણ કરવામાં A દ્વારા લેવામાં આવેલો સમય = 2.4X

⇒ A + B + C ની કુલ કાર્યક્ષમતા = 2.4X + X = 3.4X ----(1)

હવે,

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ A + B ની કાર્યક્ષમતા = 25 (675 / 27) = 25)

\n\n

⇒ એ જ રીતે, C ની કાર્યક્ષમતા = 9 (675 / 75) = 9)

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ 3.4X = 34

\n\n

⇒ X = 10 (A ની કાર્યક્ષમતા)

\n\n

⇒ જ્યારે A + B ની કાર્યક્ષમતા 25 હશે તો B ની કાર્યક્ષમતા હશે

\n\n

\n\n

∴ સાચો જવાબ 45 દિવસ છે.

Shortcut Trick 

\n\n230:Te44,\n

ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

\n\n

A ಯಿಂದ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯವು B ಮತ್ತು C ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯದ 2.4 ಪಟ್ಟು

\n\n

A ಮತ್ತು B ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು 27 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಬಹುದು

\n\n

C ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು 75 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಬಹುದು

\n\n

ಬಳಸಲಾದ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ:

\n\n

ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯವು ದಕ್ಷತೆಗೆ ವಿಲೋಮಾನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ

\n\n

ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

\n\n

B ಮತ್ತು C ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = X ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸೋಣ

\n\n

⇒ A ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ B ಮತ್ತು C ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ ಅದೇ ರೀತಿ, A ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ = X

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C ಯ ಒಟ್ಟು ದಕ್ಷತೆ = 2.4X + X = 3.4X ----(1)

\n\n

ಈಗ,

\n\n

A + B ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು 27 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದರೆ ಮತ್ತು C ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು 75 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದರೆ

\n\n

⇒ ಒಟ್ಟು ಕೆಲಸ = 675 (27 ಮತ್ತು 75 ರ LCM = 675)

\n\n

⇒ A + B ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ = 25 ((675 / 27) = 25)

\n\n

ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

\n\n

A ಯಿಂದ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯವು B ಮತ್ತು C ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯದ 2.4 ಪಟ್ಟು

\n\n

A ಮತ್ತು B ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು 27 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಬಹುದು

\n\n

C ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು 75 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಬಹುದು

\n\n

ಬಳಸಲಾದ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ:

\n\n

ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯವು ದಕ್ಷತೆಗೆ ವಿಲೋಮಾನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ

\n\n

ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

\n\n

B ಮತ್ತು C ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = X ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸೋಣ

\n\n

⇒ A ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ B ಮತ್ತು C ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ ಅದೇ ರೀತಿ, A ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ = X

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C ಯ ಒಟ್ಟು ದಕ್ಷತೆ = 2.4X + X = 3.4X ----(1)

\n\n

ಈಗ,

\n\n

A + B ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು 27 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದರೆ ಮತ್ತು C ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು 75 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದರೆ

\n\n

⇒ ಒಟ್ಟು ಕೆಲಸ = 675 (27 ಮತ್ತು 75 ರ LCM = 675)

\n\n

⇒ A + B ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ = 25 ((675 / 27) = 25)

\n\n

⇒ ಅದೇ ರೀತಿ, C ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ = 9 ((675 / 75) = 9)

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C ಯ ಒಟ್ಟು ದಕ್ಷತೆ = 34 ----------(2)

\n\n

ಸಮೀಕರಣ (1) = (2)

\n\n

⇒ 3.4X = 34

\n\n

⇒ X = 10 (A ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ)

\n\n

⇒ A + B ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ 25 ಆಗಿದ್ದರೆ B ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ

\n\n

⇒ B ಯ ದಕ್ಷತೆ = 25 - 10 = 15

\n\n

⇒ B ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ಒಂದು ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಮಯ = 675/15 = 45 ದಿನಗಳು

\n\n

∴ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ 45 ದಿನಗಳು.

\n\n231:Tf06,\n

கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ B மற்றும் C இன் செயல்திறன் = 2.4X

\n\n

⇒ இதேபோல், A = X இன் செயல்திறன்

\n\n

⇒ A + B + C இன் மொத்த செயல்திறன் = 2.4X + X = 3.4X ----(1)

\n\n

இப்போது,

\n\n

A + B ஒரு வேலையை 27 நாட்களிலும் C மட்டும் ஒரு வேலையை 75 நாட்களிலும் முடித்தால்

\n\n

⇒ A + B இன் செயல்திறன் = 25 ((675 / 27) = 25)

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ ସେହିପରି, A ର ମୋଟ ଦକ୍ଷତା = X  

\n\n

⇒  A + B + C  ର ମୋଟ ଦକ୍ଷତା = 2.4X + X = 3.4X ---- (1)

⇒ Similarly, Sale % of oranges = 15%

\n\n

⇒ Difference in sale = (15% - 10%) = 5%

\n\n

⇒ 100% = 1200

\n\n

⇒ 1% = 1200/100 = 12

\n\n

⇒ 5% = 12 × 5 = 60

\n\n

∴ The correct answer is 60.

Given:

\n\n

tanθ + cotθ = 2

θ is an acute angle (θ < 90° )

Concept used:

At θ = 45°, tanθ = cotθ = 1

\n\n

We have

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ (2 × 1) + (3 × 1) + (5 × 1 × 1) = 10

\n\n

∴ The correct answer is 10.

Given:

\n\n

PQR is an equilateral triangle

\n\n

QR = 3QS and PQ = 9 cm

\n\n

Concept Used:

\n\n

\n\n

By Stewart’s Theorem

\n\n

b2m + c2n = a (d2 + mn)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

As PQR is an equilateral triangle

\n\n

PQ = QR = PR = 9 cm

\n\n

According to the question, QR = 3QS

\n\n

⇒ QS = 9/3 = 3 cm

\n\n

⇒ SR = 6 cm

\n\n

\n\n

By Stewart’s Theorem

\n\n

(PQ2 × SR) + (PR2 × QS) = QR (d2 + QS × SR)

\n\n

⇒ (92 × 6) + (92 × 3) = 9 [d2 + (3 × 6)]

\n\n

⇒ 92 (6 + 3) = 9 [d2 + (3 × 6)]

\n\n

⇒ 81 = d2 + 18

\n\n

⇒ d2 = 63

\n\n

⇒ d = √63 cm

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

When we draw perpendicular line in equilateral triangle

\n\n

it will divide the base of triangle into two equal parts

\n\n

Sides of equilateral triangle will be equal 

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Height of equilateral triangle = √3a / 2 (where a = side of triangle)

\n\n

Pythagoras theorem C2 = √(A2 + B2) (where C = hypotenuse)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

\n\n

Let QS = 1 Ratio then QR will be 3 ratio and SR will be 2 ratio

\n\n

⇒ QR is the side of equilateral triangle = PQ = 9 cm

\n\n

According to question,

\n\n

⇒ 3 ratio = 9 cm

\n\n

⇒ 1 ratio = 3 cm (QS)

\n\n

⇒ 2 ratio = 6 cm (SR) ----(1)

\n\n

Draw a perpendicular(PM) on base (QR)

\n\n

⇒ QM = MR = 4.5 cm ----(2)

\n\n

From (1) - (2)

\n\n

⇒ SM = 1.5 cm = 3/2 cm

\n\n

Now,

\n\n

⇒ Height of equilateral triangle (PM) = √3a/2 = (√3 × 9) / 2

\n\n

From Pythagoras theorem

\n\n

⇒ PS = √( PM2 + SM2) = √((9√3 / 2)2 + (1.5)2)

\n\n

⇒ PS = √ ((243/4) + (9/4)) = √(252/4) = √63

\n\n

∴ The correct answer is √63.

दिया गया:

PQR एक समबाहु त्रिभुज है

QR = 3QS और PQ = 9 सेमी

\n\n

\n\n

स्टीवर्ट के प्रमेय द्वारा

\n\n

b2m + c2n = a (d2 + mn)

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

चूँकि PQR एक समबाहु त्रिभुज है

\n\n

PQ = QR = PR = 9 सेमी

\n\n

प्रश्न के अनुसार, QR = 3QS

\n\n

⇒ QS = 9/3 = 3 सेमी

\n\n

⇒ SR = 6 सेमी

\n\n

\n\n

स्टीवर्ट के प्रमेय द्वारा

\n\n

(PQ2 × SR) + (PR2 × QS) = QR (d2 + QS × SR)

\n\n

⇒ (92 × 6) + (92 × 3) = 9 [d2 + (3 × 6)]

\n\n

⇒ 92 (6 + 3) = 9 [d2 + (3 × 6)]

\n\n

⇒ 81 = d2 + 18

\n\n

⇒ d2 = 63

\n\n

⇒ d = √63 सेमी

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n\n

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा: 

\n\n

जब हम समबाहु त्रिभुज में लम्ब रेखा खींचते हैं, तो यह त्रिभुज के आधार को दो बराबर भागों में विभाजित करेगा।

\n\n

समबाहु त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ बराबर होंगी।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

समबाहु त्रिभुज की ऊँचाई = √3a / 2 (जहाँ a = त्रिभुज की भुजा)

\n\n

पाइथागोरस प्रमेय  C2 = √(A2 + B2) (जहाँ C = कर्ण)

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

\n\n

माना QS = 1 अनुपात है, तो QR, 3 अनुपात होगा और SR, 2 अनुपात होगा।

\n\n

⇒ QR समबाहु त्रिभुज की भुजा है = PQ = 9 सेमी

\n\n

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

\n\n

⇒ 3 अनुपात = 9 सेमी

\n\n

⇒ 1 अनुपात = 3 सेमी (QS)

\n\n

⇒ 2 अनुपात = 6 सेमी (SR) ----(1)

\n\n

आधार (QR) पर एक लंब (PM) खींचिए 

\n\n

⇒ QM = MR = 4.5 सेमी ----(2)

\n\n

(1) - (2) से

\n\n

⇒ SM = 1.5 सेमी = 3/2 सेमी

\n\n

अब,

\n\n

⇒ समबाहु त्रिभुज की ऊँचाई (PM) = √3a/2 = (√3 × 9) / 2

\n\n

पाइथागोरस प्रमेय से

\n\n

⇒ PS = √( PM2 + SM2) = √((9√3 / 2)2 + (1.5)2)

\n\n

⇒ PS = √ ((243/4) + (9/4)) = √(252/4) = √63

\n\n

∴ सही उत्तर √63 है।

\n\n

              The correct answer is: has dedicated.

              \n\n

              Key Points

              \n\n
                \n\t
              • The given sentence is in the present perfect tense.
                • \n\t
              • The present perfect tense is formed with "has" or "have" followed by the past participle of the verb. \n\t
                  \n\t\t
                • For example: Vinay has moved into a new apartment.
                  • \n\t
                \n\t
                • \n\t
              • Similarly, in the given question, after 'has', the past participle form of the verb (dedicated) must be used.
                • \n\t
              • Hence, 'has dedicated' is the correct answer.
                • \n
              \n\n

              Therefore, the correct answer is: Lily has dedicated her life towards becoming a doctor.

              \n\n

              Additional Information

              \n\n
                \n\t

                  \n\t\t
                • 'had dedicate': This is an attempt to form a past perfect tense ("had dedicated") but fails as it uses the base form "dedicate" instead of the past participle "dedicated." The correct past perfect form would be "had dedicated," but in this sentence, past perfect is not appropriate as we are talking about an action impacting the present.
                  • \n\t\t
                • \n\t\t
                  'is dedicate': This option incorrectly attempts to construct a present tense using "is" (a present form of "to be") with "dedicate." The correct present tense formation would involve using "is dedicating" if we wanted to depict an ongoing action; however, the intended meaning is about a commitment that spans past to present, making the present perfect tense ("has dedicated") more appropriate.
                  \n\t\t
                  • \n\t
                \n\t
                • \n

                The correct answer is "Despite".

                \n\n

                Key Points

                \n\n
                  \n\t

                  • \n\t

                    \n\t\t

                • Hence, the correct answer is "Despite".

                \n\n

                  • \n\t
                • "In despite of" is not a correct phrase in English.
                  • \n

                The correct answer is: 'Forgets'.

                \n\n

                Key Points

                • The erroneous part of the given sentence is: 'Forget'.
                  • \n\t
                • The given sentence is in the 'Present Indefinite Tense'.
                  • \n\t
                • So, the rule is: "Subject + Verb( 1st form) + Object".
                  • \n\t
                • According to the rule, the subject is in Singular form.
                  • \n\t
                • So, verb must be 'forgets' to make the sentence correct.\n\t
                    \n\t\t
                  • Example: Robin forgets the address of the place.

                  • \n
                \n\n

                Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.

                Additional Information

                \n\n

                  • \n\t
                • Option 2: 'have been forgetting' used in 'Present Perfect Tense'.
                  • \n\t
                • Option 3: 'forgot' used in 'Past Indefinite Tense'.
                  • \n

                The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

                \n\n

                He are very thirsty. / Give him / a little water to drink.

                \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Give him"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "a little water to drink"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "He are very thirsty"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "No error"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                The erroneous part is: 'He are very thirsty'.

                \n\n

                Key Points

                \n\n
                  \n\t
                • The error in the given sentence is the use of 'are' after the singular pronoun 'He'.
                  • \n\t
                • Here, the subject is a singular third-person pronoun 'He', so the corresponding verb form should also be singular 'is'.\n\t
                    \n\t\t
                  • Corrected sentence: "He is very thirsty. / Give him / a little water to drink."
                    • \n\t
                  \n\t
                  • \n\t
                • This maintains the proper subject-verb agreement, and the sentence is grammatically correct.
                  • \n\t
                • Hence, 'He are very thirsty' is the erroneous part.
                  • \n
                \n\n

                Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.

                \n\n

                Additional Information

                \n\n
                  \n\t
                •  According to subject-verb agreement, when the subject is a singular third-person pronoun like 'he', 'she' or 'it' the corresponding verb form should also be singular.\n\n\t
                    \n\t\t
                  • Incorrect: She are going to the market.
                    • \n\t\t
                  • Correct: She is going to the market.
                    • \n\t
                  \n\t
                  • \n
                ", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Grammar"], "concept": "Grammar", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6528280c03bbc4e322c58996", "qs_no": 33, "pos_marks": 1.0, "neg_marks": 0.25, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "

                The Correct answer is "Talking nonsense"

                \n\n

                Key Points

                \n\n

                Hence, the correct option is 'option 3'.

                        Complete passage is: The concept of motivation focuses on explaining what ‘moves’ behaviour. In fact, the term (1)motivation is derived from the Latin word ‘movere’, referring to movement of activity. Most of our everyday explanation of (2)behaviour is given in terms of motives. Motives also help in making (3)predictions about behaviour. A person will work hard in school, in sports, in business, in music, and in many other situations, if he/she has a very strong need for (4)achievements. Hence, motives are the general states that enable us to make predictions about behaviour in many different situations. In other words, motivation is one of the (5)determinants of behaviour. Instincts, drives, needs, goals, and incentives come under the broad cluster of motivation.
